The '''Reaper&#39;s World system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Nilgaard sector/Legends|Nilgaard sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reaper's World/Legends|Reaper's World]].
